high_level_description: This image is an aerial view of a residential construction site. The scene shows several houses under various stages of completion. Some houses have completed roofs, while others still have flat or unfinished roofs. The surrounding area includes dirt paths, construction materials, and some greenery, indicating ongoing development. The text overlay on the image reads: "Britain's chronic housing shortage is about to get even worse." This suggests that the image is part of a news article or report from Bloomberg.com, as indicated by the link at the bottom of the image.
